data.one_liner: Offline raster tile provider for flutter_map using MBTiles
data.what_it_does: Provides a TileProvider that reads raster tiles (jpg, png, webp) from an MBTiles SQLite database. It can be used with flutter_map to display fully offline maps.
use_when: You need offline map support with raster tiles
You already use flutter_map and want to avoid network requests
Your tile data is stored in an MBTiles file
avoid_when: You target web platform (no SQLite support)
strengths: Zero extra setup on supported platforms
weaknesses: Requires file system access and permissions
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_map_mbtiles to pubspec, provide path to .mbtiles file, call dispose() when done

alternatives.name: vector_map_tiles_mbtiles
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use for vector tiles instead of raster
